name: Skinamp
author: idrewlong
description: The Spotify player you can skin. A music icon in the bar with a rich mini player on hover (cover, live spectrum, the current lyric line, seek, transport, like, volume); click it for the full player with eleven looks, from today's Spotify app to Winamp, iPod and Windows Media Player, plus real visualizers.

barWidget.description: Music icon with a mini player on hover; click to open Skinamp
